notes: Manually read every eligible production source file and both metadata files. The source commit is d912f0c06e7af29a4a40c4211bec0bb76d473f10. Root/extensions/SDK instructions and benchmark contract/entire README were read; no Inspector implementation, helpers, detector output or other fixture was consulted.

The plugin owns 55 eligible production source files. Local imports (including src/gemini-web-search-provider.runtime.ts importing ../google-api-client-header.js) stay inside extensions/google. No additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source outside the root was identified. SDK implementations and separately installed @google/genai, google-auth-library and dotenv packages are outside the audited source boundary.

All 52 SDK specifiers are explicit public package exports in the pinned root package.json. Corresponding SDK facades were inspected to verify exported names; canonical identities stop at their named public SDK exports rather than following internal implementations or transitive package dependencies.

model-id.ts reexports normalizeAntigravityPreviewModelId and normalizeGooglePreviewModelId under local aliases. api.ts/runtime-api.ts and downstream imports retain their original SDK-export identities. Both unchanged function arguments to normalizeProviderModels reach the normalizeId(id) call, establishing call references for both original exports.

thinking-api.ts, api.ts and runtime-api.ts form local SDK reexport chains. Explicit inline type specifiers and export type sites remain type dependencies, including transport-stream.ts uses of GoogleThinkingInputLevel and GoogleThinkingLevel. Unused value reexports remain runtime syntactic dependencies.

resolveFamilyForwardCompatModel, buildGuardedModelFetch and createProviderOperationDeadline have both value imports/calls and direct typeof type references. sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest combines a value import, named dynamic import, explicit import type, calls and typeof type use. Their export classifications are mixed; later type uses do not independently change SDK-module classification.

The register callbacks in index.ts and setup-api.ts receive OpenClawPluginApi through definePluginEntry (verified in src/plugin-sdk/plugin-entry.ts and src/plugins/plugin-definition.types.ts). They call ten distinct public registration members. No API on/registerHook registrations or PluginRuntime-derived values/type projections occur.

ProviderPlugin hooks, CliBackendPlugin callbacks, speech/realtime bridge contexts, providerConfig.apiKey, MemoryEmbeddingProviderAdapter create-result runtime, GoogleGenAI clients and SDK helper return values are not OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime handles. Their members therefore do not create api-member/runtime-member findings; imported types/helpers are recorded independently.

Speech SDK dynamic imports destructure named exports directly; they add dynamic-import without a synthetic namespace/star export or local-container member-access. createLazyRuntimeSurface/createLazyRuntimeModule wrap plugin-local modules, not SDK modules; no transitive helper-internal SDK calls are inferred.

The manifest contributes three providers and eight contracts entries. cliBackends, capabilityCatalogEntry, providerCatalogEntry, setup, model catalog, configContracts, descriptive/configuration fields and capability metadata are reviewed metadata but outside the frozen manifest-contract identity fields.

Three ambiguous test helper filenames were individually read and caller-verified as test-only. vertex-adc.ts remains production source despite its conditional VITEST reset hook; the source-phase contract is file-scoped.

findingCount counts distinct fixture findings evidenced in each reviewed file. Evidence samples represent all observed reference kinds; classification describes source syntax, not whether a helper executes or appears in a published artifact.

Final source-only reconciliation: REALTIME_VOICE_AUDIO_FORMAT_G711_ULAW_8KHZ is retained unchanged as the fallback of the readonly GoogleRealtimeVoiceBridge.audioFormat property (realtime-voice-provider.ts:410). Later property selection/forwarding at line 587 and direct encoding/sampleRateHz reads at line 770 establish member-access on that original exported-root identity. This records the possible fallback branch without claiming execution or inferring internal behavior of SDK helpers; classification, identities and file coverage remain unchanged.
